text.tspan: “Generate my self-appraisal PDF and draft an email to Darshan about it”
Typed or spoken, in plain language
Agent loop · tool_choice: auto · at most 6 legs
every step and its arguments persisted server-side
Approval card · “Sanchaya wants to make 2 changes to your account”
sends the plan id — never the arguments
re-checks ownership · re-reads the arguments from the row · runs them in order
Any step fails → the whole plan rolls back
Per-step success or failure in the timeline · dashboard caches invalidated
The model proposes. The professor decides. The server is the only thing that executes.
